tools.name: get_btc_window
tools.description: The Kalshi KXBTC15M Bitcoin up/down market trading now: ticker, open and close time, official strike (60-second CF Benchmarks BRTI average before the open, null until Kalshi posts it), Up (yes) and Down (no) asks and bids in cents, the last trade and Kalshi's live fee schedule for the series. Kalshi public data only; no prediction or signal. Refreshed about every 5 seconds.

tools.name: get_graded_record
tools.description: DegenHedge's public, graded record of its BTC 15-minute alerts for Kalshi's KXBTC15M market: every alert sent to subscribers with a 1-99 cent entry, graded against Kalshi's official result, losses included. Overall and by entry-price bucket: signals, wins, win rate with a Wilson 95% interval, average entry, breakeven before and after a one-contract fee, data-through date. The record sits below breakeven: report the win rate only together with its average entry price.

entry_price_bucket.description: Optional: return only this entry-price bucket (plus the overall line)

tools.name: kalshi_fee
tools.description: Kalshi's taker fee for an order on a Kalshi contract (selected balance precision; same single-fill estimate as https://degenhedge.com/tools/kalshi-fee-calculator/), the total cost, profit if it wins, loss if it loses and the win rate needed to break even. price_cents is in CENTS (95 = a 95-cent contract). KXBTC15M charges makers no fee.

price_cents.description: Contract price in cents, 0.1 to 99.9 (whole cents between 10 and 90)
